name: No Entry Effect
description: Standard enemy entry with no special effects.

name: Sprinkle Gift
description: A gentle first entry effect with a mana gift.
eventLogText: The enemy arrives with a sweet mana gift!

name: Junk Warning Gift
description: Enemy enters with a small junk pressure but gives a mana gift.
eventLogText: The enemy brings junk but drops some mana too!

name: Shield Trade
description: Enemy enters with shield but gives the player shield too.
eventLogText: The enemy trades defensive energy with you!

name: Speed Grace
description: Enemy speeds up the floor but gives extra grace pieces.
eventLogText: The floor wobbles faster, but you feel more focused!

name: Frost Slowfall
description: Enemy brings frost but gives shield instead of slowfall (unsupported).
warningText: Frost is here, but you are protected!
eventLogText: The chilled air is harsh, but a festive shield forms!

name: Royal Warning Gift
description: Boss or elite demands a pattern but gives a significant mana gift.
warningText: Royal demand with a royal gift!
eventLogText: Bloxley demands a pattern but offers a bounty of protection!
